mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_ID, ROLE_ID, MGROUP_ID, NAME, CODE, ICON_STYLE, IMAGE_PATH, TPL_SOLUTION, IS_COMMON_GROUP, IS_LEADER_GROUP, LEADER_LEVEL, IS_WORK_GROUP, IS_GRID_GROUP, IS_PARTY_GROUP, IS_VILLAGE_GROUP, IS_DISABLED, PRIORITY, CREATOR_ID, CREATE_TIME, DESCRIPTION FROM PUBLIC_GROUP WHERE GROUP_ID = #{value}

SELECT B.GROUP_ID, B.ROLE_ID, B.MGROUP_ID, B.NAME, B.CODE, B.ICON_STYLE, B.IMAGE_PATH, B.TPL_SOLUTION, B.IS_COMMON_GROUP, B.IS_LEADER_GROUP, B.LEADER_LEVEL, B.IS_WORK_GROUP, B.IS_GRID_GROUP, B.IS_PARTY_GROUP, B.IS_VILLAGE_GROUP, B.IS_DISABLED, B.PRIORITY, B.CREATOR_ID, B.CREATE_TIME, B.DESCRIPTION FROM PUBLIC_GROUP B WHERE 1=1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PUBLIC_GROUP B WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT B.GROUP_ID, B.ROLE_ID, B.MGROUP_ID, B.NAME, B.CODE, B.ICON_STYLE, B.IMAGE_PATH, B.TPL_SOLUTION, B.IS_COMMON_GROUP, B.IS_LEADER_GROUP, B.LEADER_LEVEL, B.IS_WORK_GROUP, B.IS_GRID_GROUP, B.IS_PARTY_GROUP, B.IS_VILLAGE_GROUP, B.IS_DISABLED, B.PRIORITY, B.CREATOR_ID, B.CREATE_TIME, B.DESCRIPTION , sr.NAME as roleName FROM PUBLIC_GROUP B
WHERE 1=1
mapper.sql:
left join SYS_ROLE sr on B.ROLE_ID =sr.ROLE_ID
and sr.APP_ID = #{appId}
mapper.select:
SELECT B.GROUP_ID, B.ROLE_ID, B.MGROUP_ID, B.NAME, B.CODE, B.ICON_STYLE, B.IMAGE_PATH, B.TPL_SOLUTION, B.IS_COMMON_GROUP, B.IS_LEADER_GROUP, B.LEADER_LEVEL, B.IS_WORK_GROUP, B.IS_GRID_GROUP, B.IS_PARTY_GROUP, B.IS_VILLAGE_GROUP, B.IS_DISABLED, B.PRIORITY, B.CREATOR_ID, B.CREATE_TIME, B.DESCRIPTION , sr.NAME as roleName FROM PUBLIC_GROUP B
WHERE GROUP_ID = #{value}

select * FROM PUBLIC_GROUP where CODE=#{code} and IS_DISABLED=0
LIMIT 1
LIMIT 1
AND rownum<=1

select R.ROLETYPE_ID from PUBLIC_GROUP B left join SYS_ROLE R on R.ROLE_ID = B.ROLE_ID where B.GROUP_ID=#{groupId}
LIMIT 1
LIMIT 1
AND rownum<=1
SELECT NAME AS name, GROUP_ID as cddValue FROM PUBLIC_GROUP B
SELECT NAME AS name, GROUP_ID as cddValue FROM PUBLIC_GROUP B WHERE B.DEL_FLAG = 0 ORDER BY PRIORITY ASC
